info.adoration: Adoration Room open daily 6am–10.30pm. First Friday Adoration at 7pm.
good_to_know: For Last Rites or urgent care of the seriously ill outside office hours, call 6344 0046 to reach the priest on duty.
Columbarium open daily 6am–10pm; lift hours daily 9am–7pm, and 8.30am–12 noon on public holidays.
Katong Catholic Shop: Tues–Fri 12 noon–6.30pm, Sat–Sun 8.30am–5.30pm; closed Mondays and public holidays.

events.title: CaFE video series 'Let It Be Done To Me' (morning sessions)
events.text: Five weekly sessions on Mother Mary at Church Level 4 Function Hall Dome, 9.30–10.45am, on 12, 19 and 26 Oct and 2 Nov. Video screenings, discussion, prayer and praise & worship.

events.title: Remembering Our Faithful Departed
events.text: Tuesdays 6 Oct–17 Nov at Pastoral Centre Level 3 St Ephrem Room, 7.45–9.30pm with potluck fellowship from 7pm. Register by QR code; facilitators welcome, training provided.

events.title: CaFE video series 'Let It Be Done To Me' (evening sessions)
events.text: Five weekly sessions on Mother Mary at Church Level 4 Function Hall Big Room, 8.00–9.30pm, on 15, 22 and 29 Oct and 5 Nov. Video screenings, discussion, prayer and praise & worship.

events.title: Talk on Mother Mary in the Marian Month of October
events.text: Friar Derrick Yap OFM speaks on 'St Francis of Assisi's Love and Devotion to Our Lady' at the Main Church, 7.45–9.30pm. Includes Marian hymns and the Rosary; all are welcome.

events.title: Intercessory Prayer Session
events.text: At the Adoration Room, 8.00–9.30pm. Petitions and thanksgiving prayers can be submitted by QR code to be offered at the session.

events.title: The Wild Goose video series
events.text: Sessions on the Holy Spirit at Pastoral Centre Level 1 Multi-Purpose Hall, 8.00–9.30pm; this session covers the readings for All Saints Day. No registration required.

events.title: Joo Chiat NCC Fellowship dinner
events.text: Dinner after the 5.30pm sunset Mass at the chat corner, ground floor of the Parish Pastoral Centre, for anyone connected with Joo Chiat Neighbourhood Christian Community. RSVP at https://forms.gle/c9akXvmoSKDeAzvR8 or contact Philip Ho at 96694987.
